g.title: PlayerQSystem
g.text: Handles primary gameplay logic for players.
Uses other classes for specific player logic.

g.title: PlayerMovementController
g.text: Handles the logic for moving and rotating player characters.

g.title: PlayerBotController
g.text: Handles AI and other logic for bots.

g.title: PlayerClassManager
g.text: Handles the initial loading of player classes

g.title: PlayerManagerData
g.text: accessed by other classes through PlayerHandle.

g.title: PlayerHandle
g.text: which allows other classes to access PlayerManagerData for each individual player.

g.title: PlayerManager
g.text: allowing other parts of the code to focus on gameplay logic.

g.title: PlayerShieldManager
g.text: allowing other parts of the code to focus on gameplay logic.

g.title: PlayerClassData
g.text: which is specific to a player character class.
